name: Fireflies.ai
tagline: AI meeting bot that records, transcribes, summarizes, and searches calls

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked 2026-07-30; Pro is listed at $18/seat/month monthly and $10/seat/month annually.

verdictSummary: The summarizer is easy; the meeting bot, calendar routing, integrations, team search, and admin layer make it more than a one-prompt clone.
coreLoopDIY: Create a recorder/bot, capture call audio, transcribe, generate summaries/action items, store transcripts, and add keyword search.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because the bot reliably appears, captures, files, and shares notes across the whole team.

priorArt.name: whisper.cpp
priorArt.desc: Provides the commodity transcription layer; the SaaS moat is the meeting/integration layer

alternatives.name: Fathom
alternatives.desc: Unlimited recording, transcription, basic summaries, clips and search for one person; the revenue-team machinery remains paid.

alternatives.name: OpenWhispr
alternatives.desc: One installer records meetings without a bot, labels speakers, summarizes them and keeps the archive searchable.

alternatives.name: Speakr
alternatives.desc: A polished self-hosted call archive with transcription, summaries, search and chat; zero subscription, nonzero server.

notes: Useful contrast with Granola: same AI primitive, harder product surface.
prompt:
Build me a searchable call transcript archive to replace Fireflies.ai. Requirements:

- A Node pipeline plus a local web app (Express + better-sqlite3, localhost).
- Ingest: watch ~/Recordings/ with chokidar, or `calls add <file>`. Transcribe
  locally with whisper.cpp, or Deepgram/OpenAI Whisper if a key is in .env.
- Summarize each call with an LLM (key in .env): overview, action items with
  owners, questions asked, next steps. Store summary and full transcript in
  SQLite.
- Search page: FTS5 keyword search across every transcript ever, results show
  matching lines with timestamps and link into the full transcript.
- Topic tracker: topics.json holds keywords (competitor names, pricing, churn);
  a page lists every call where each topic came up, newest first.
- Export any call to Markdown in ~/Calls/notes/YYYY-MM-DD-<name>.md.
- No accounts, no telemetry; audio stays local unless I opt into a hosted API.
- Out of scope: a bot that joins Zoom/Meet/Teams, calendar routing, CRM sync,
  and team sharing. I supply the recordings myself.
- README: dependencies, optional keys, and how to record call audio on my OS.
